title: He et al. 2025 — VocalMind: A Stereotactic EEG Dataset for Vocalized, Mimed, and Imagined Speech in Tonal Language
description: VocalMind is a stereotactic EEG (sEEG) dataset comprising intracranial recordings from a single participant performing vocalized, mimed, and imagined speech tasks in Mandarin Chinese, a tonal language. The dataset supports research on speech decoding, brain-computer interfaces, and neural mechanisms of overt and covert speech production. Raw recordings sampled at 1000 Hz have been converted to BIDS iEEG format with event markers indicating stimulus onsets for each speech modality.
methods_description: Intracranial EEG recordings were obtained at 1000 Hz sampling rate while participants performed three speech tasks: vocalized speech, mimed speech, and imagined speech in Mandarin Chinese. Per-trial recordings were concatenated per speech mode/task type with events.tsv files marking stimulus onsets. Data were converted to BIDS iEEG BrainVision format using the EEGDash conversion pipeline.
